sam_cs: Quick sync: NovusEdge dedicated bring-up scheduled Fri 2026-05-07 08:00 PT. Scope: quota checks, autoscale tuning, and two loadtest passes (canary + stress). Need owners.
eli_infra: I can lead infra. Contracted reserved: 10xA100. They requested burst to 14 for peak. Need to confirm billing rate and preapproval for burst.
mona_sre: Autoscale suggestion: min=4, target_gpu_util=0.72, max=14, burst_window=10m. Recommend probe window for scale decisions = 60s and max_scale_step=2 instances to avoid oscillation.
rhys_oncall: I'll take monitoring. Plan: baseline metrics p50/p95/p99, error-rate, queue_len, token_cost/1k. If p99 latency >750ms or errors >0.8% persist for 3m, trigger fallback. Ping me 8m pre-run.
sam_cs: We need KV cache priming — long-context chat flows. Also ask product to confirm conversation prefixes to prime.
eli_infra: Adding a priming job: 200 sample conversations, hitting prefixes and seeding KV. Will run 20m before canary.
mona_sre: Load profile: canary 6m @30 RPS, ramp 12m to 500 RPS, sustain 8m, then step spike 3m @800 RPS to validate burst. We'll simulate multi-turn with ~2.2k tokens/session.
eli_infra: Load scripts here: s3://redwood-loads/novusedge/2026-05-06/novusedge-v2.tar.gz. Example: `k6 run --vus 600 --duration 30m chat_scenario.js`. Will include header tags: account=novusedge-prod, route=dedicated-v2`.
ops_bot: Reminder: runbook 'dedicated-onramp' has new checklist items for burst billing opt-in. See https://internal.redwood/runbooks/dedicated-onramp#burst-billing.
rhys_oncall: Fallback plan: route heavy writes to hosted-fallback (v2.0) with feature flags: disable streaming, short-context mode. Also throttle new sessions if reserved_pool >92% for 5m.
eli_infra: Draft autoscale config (to PR):
```
min_instances: 4
max_instances: 14
scale_metric: avg_gpu_usage
target: 0.72
probe_period_seconds: 60
max_scale_step: 2
cooldown_seconds: 240
```
I'll open PR and tag @mona_sre for review.
sam_cs: Please add quota alert rule to notify #cs-novusedge and #ops-oncall: reserved_consumption >85% for 8m -> notify + pause new onramps. Also capture per-token billing labels for finance.
mona_sre: Will add tracing headers to measure kv_hit_rate and add a short eval comparing latency reserved vs hosted fallback. Also enable temporary debug metrics endpoint.
eli_infra: PR: https://git.internal/infra/novusedge-autoscale/pull/21 (assigning @mona_sre). Aim to merge by EOD Thu to let config settle.
rhys_oncall: I'll prepare the watch doc and run a pre-check at 07:30 PT. Also will be on the call for the customer sync at 07:45.
sam_cs: I'll send calendar invite to NovusEdge SRE for 07:45 PT and include the renewal rep in case utilization trends look persistent post-run. Thanks team — let's keep post-run notes concise and capture cost deltas.
